FarmerMasterRecord.title: Farmer Master Record
FarmerMasterRecord.description: One master record per farmer keyed by 10-digit Indian mobile number. Stores profile, field size, address with GPS & accuracy, confirmed map location, crops, emergency contact, consent record, AI call consent & history, spray log, advice history, and callback requests. Photos are stored only if photoConsentGiven is true.

ownerUid.description: Session or Firebase Auth UID of the farmer device

confirmedLocation.description: Confirmed map pin coordinates, accuracy, and place name

gpsAccuracyMeters.description: Best GPS accuracy reading in meters

locationManuallyConfirmed.description: Whether location was confirmed on map

fieldSize.description: Entered field size value, unit, and converted acres

emergencyContact.description: Optional emergency contact name and phone

aiCallConsent.description: Whether farmer agreed to receive AI assistant calls

photoConsentGiven.description: Whether farmer agreed to store photos on server

photoDataUrl.description: Profile photo data URL (present on server ONLY if photoConsentGiven is true)

adviceHistory.description: Saved crop, water, fertiliser, and disease advice history

callbackRequests.description: IVR missed-call and callback request records

fieldTimestamps.description: Per-field last-modified epoch ms for conflict resolution

lastSyncedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last server sync

CorrectionRequest.title: Locked Field Correction Request
CorrectionRequest.description: Submitted by a farmer to request changes to locked fields. Approved or rejected by an admin.

FarmerIdIndex.title: Farmer ID Uniqueness Index
FarmerIdIndex.description: Maps unique Farmer ID (KB-XXX-123456) to mobile key

/farmers/{mobile}.description: Master record per farmer keyed by 10-digit mobile number. Single-doc get/write validated by mobile key; list restricted strictly to admin.

/correctionRequests/{requestId}.description: Correction requests for locked address/GPS fields. Farmers can create and read their own; only admins can approve/reject.
